shortlist.story: A project at Barts Health NHS Trust is using AI-powered eye-tracking to help patients who cannot speak find a way to communicate.
shortlist.best_title: Barts Health project sees AI eye-tracking tech to help patients with speech difficulties communicate
shortlist.why: Real named NHS project; AI is the core enabling technology; affects a vulnerable patient group outside the AI industry; plausibly in trial or early deployment.

shortlist.story: An AI system reading standard ECG traces has shown it can detect dangerously low potassium levels in the blood, a condition that normally requires a blood test to identify.
shortlist.best_title: AI-ECG Shows Promise for Monitoring Severe Hypokalemia
shortlist.why: Clinical study result on a specialist medical outlet; AI is the reason a non-invasive test can flag a dangerous condition; plausible direct patient benefit outside the AI industry.

shortlist.story: Mayo Clinic researchers built and tested an AI model that uses a routine 24-hour urine test to predict kidney stone composition more accurately than existing methods, potentially sparing patients from more invasive procedures.
shortlist.best_title: Mayo Clinic researchers use AI to better predict kidney stone composition
shortlist.why: Named institution, real study released via EurekaAlert; item 119 gives the full source detail; AI is the reason for improved accuracy; directly benefits patients outside the AI industry.

shortlist.story: The NHS is running a trial of an AI assistant that proactively phones patients with long-term conditions to check on them, aiming to free up clinical time and catch people who might otherwise be missed.
shortlist.best_title: NHS trials AI assistant to phone patients with long-term illness
shortlist.why: Real named NHS trial; AI is what makes the proactive outreach scalable; outside the AI industry; plausible evidence implied by a formal trial.

shortlist.story: A study of more than 280,000 AI-read ECGs found that financial stress and food insecurity show up in the heart's electrical patterns, suggesting economic hardship accelerates cardiac ageing.
shortlist.best_title: More than 280,000 AI-read ECGs point to money worries and food insecurity as major markers of an older-looking heart
shortlist.why: Very large dataset gives real evidential weight; AI analysis surfaced a finding humans reviewing ECGs would not have spotted; the result is about health and social conditions outside the AI industry and has wide human appeal.

shortlist.story: Samsung Medical Centre in South Korea is testing an AI speech-to-text system that transcribes doctor-patient consultations directly into medical records, reducing paperwork for clinicians.
shortlist.best_title: Samsung Medical Centre tests AI speech-to-text for medical records
shortlist.why: Named hospital running a real test; AI is the reason the administrative burden can be lifted; outside the AI industry; plausibly at trial stage with real-world evidence.

shortlist.story: Perth astronomers used an AI originally trained on cat photos to independently reconstruct the famous first image of a black hole, and the bright ring came out the same, confirming the original result by a completely different method.
shortlist.best_title: Perth scientists confirm famous black hole image using AI
shortlist.why: It happened; AI is the reason for the independent confirmation; a science result entirely outside the AI industry; the 'trained on cat photos' angle is a genuine surprise with broad public appeal.

shortlist.story: An AI tool scanning the Linux kernel—software that runs most of the world's servers and smartphones—found security bugs that had gone undetected for decades.
shortlist.best_title: AI found Linux kernel bugs that remained undetected for decades
shortlist.why: It happened; AI is the reason the decades-old bugs were found; affects critical global infrastructure used by billions outside the AI industry; broad practical significance that is easy to explain.

shortlist.story: A multimodal AI system accurately detected Alzheimer's disease in clinical tests, though it was less reliable at determining how advanced the disease was.
shortlist.best_title: Multimodal Artificial Intelligence Accurately Detects Alzheimer Disease but Stumbles on Staging
shortlist.why: Study result on a named, widely feared disease; AI is the detection tool; the honest mixed finding (detection yes, staging uncertain) suggests real reporting rather than hype; high public relevance outside the AI industry.

shortlist.story: A systematic review of ten years of research concluded that AI can help cut carbon emissions and adapt to climate change at every stage of a construction project, from producing materials to demolition, while noting it is not a complete solution on its own.
shortlist.best_title: AI can help construction cut emissions and brace for climate change, but it is no silver bullet
shortlist.why: Systematic review gives solid evidential weight; AI is the enabling tool across the supply chain; construction is a major real-world emissions source; the 'no silver bullet' caveat signals honest, credible reporting.

shortlist.story: Several nonprofit advocacy groups have filed lawsuits against major AI companies seeking to pause the release of new frontier models, arguing the pace of development poses catastrophic risks.
shortlist.best_title: Advocacy groups sue AI giants to freeze new models, warning of 'catastrophic' risks
shortlist.why: Widely covered bad-news story about unchecked AI development; the lawsuits are a concrete 'system is responding' fact separate from the underlying concern; no person was physically harmed; the good side does not shrink the harm but adds to it by showing accountability mechanisms activating.
